item.title: Public hearing comments about $41.9M budget too late for amendments
item.description: Deb Snyder addresses City Council about the proposed 2026-27 budget during Monday's conference meeting at City Hall.Photo by Joanne Beck If the city of Batavia fire chief cannot handle his job without hiring an assistant, then maybe he’s not the right person for the position, Deb Snyder says.Snyder was one of two citizens and two City Council members to express concern about including an assistant fire chief position within the proposed $41.9 million budget during Monday’s public hearing.
